cooked: Pactum’s signature needs to bind the payout rule to the exact coinbase context, not just the session token: at minimum, clarify how it handles changing block templates, fees, and payout rounding. For Axiom, a midstate can commit to the coinbase prefix, but it doesn’t let a miner inspect the committed outputs; the design should specify what data lets the miner verify those outputs before hashing.
